name: U.S. grades of butter
steps: U.S. Grade AA > U.S. Grade A > U.S. Grade B
notes: grade by flavour first then body, colour, salt; butter failing workmanship limit gets flavour rating only; 93/92/90 point scores are from Wikipedia not USDA page

steps: U.S. Grade AA > U.S. Grade A > U.S. Grade B > U.S. Grade C

name: U.S. grades of Monterey (Monterey Jack) cheese
steps: U.S. Grade AA > U.S. Grade A > U.S. Grade B
notes: missing kind?: Monterey Jack (no J3 kind)

name: U.S. grades of Colby cheese
steps: U.S. Grade AA > U.S. Grade A > U.S. Grade B
notes: missing kind?: Colby (no J3 kind)

name: U.S. grades of Swiss cheese, Emmentaler cheese
steps: U.S. Grade A > U.S. Grade B > U.S. Grade C

name: U.S. grades of nonfat dry milk, spray process
steps: U.S. Extra Grade > U.S. Standard Grade

name: U.S. grades of nonfat dry milk, roller process
steps: U.S. Extra > U.S. Standard

name: U.S. consumer grades of shell eggs
steps: USDA Grade AA > USDA Grade A > USDA Grade B
notes: grade independent of size; B mostly breaking stock

name: U.S. weight classes for shell eggs
steps: Jumbo > Extra Large > Large > Medium > Small > Peewee
notes: minimum per dozen 30, 27, 24, 21, 18, 15 oz (Wikipedia derives dozen figures); MN state rule lists Jumbo to Small at 30 27 24 21 18 oz

name: EU weight grades for Class A eggs
steps: XL > L > M > S
notes: XL 73 g or more; L 63 to under 73; M 53 to under 63; S under 53; wording on Irish FSAI page citing the EU rules

name: EU egg quality classes
steps: Class A > Class B
notes: Class A for sale to consumers; B for industry

name: EU egg farming method codes
steps: 0 organic > 1 free range > 2 barn > 3 enriched cage
notes: code 0 organic, 1 free range, 2 barn, 3 eggs from enriched caged hens; ordered 0 to 3

name: EU drinking milk fat classes (Regulation 2597/97)
steps: Whole milk (at least 3.50% fat) > Semi-skimmed milk (1.50 to 1.80%) > Skimmed milk (0.50% or less)
notes: Member States may add whole milk at 4.00% or more

name: Canada egg grades
steps: Canada A > Canada B > Canada C > Canada Nest Run

name: Canada A egg size designations
steps: Jumbo > Extra Large > Large > Medium > Small > Peewee
notes: minimum weights Jumbo 70 g, XL 63, Large 56, Medium 49, Small 42; size only for Canada A

name: Canada dairy product grades (butter, Cheddar)
steps: Canada 1
notes: single grade name for butter and Cheddar

name: Canada dry milk product grades
steps: Canada 1 > Canada 2

name: Australian egg sizes (Australian Eggs labelling guide)
steps: King > Jumbo > Extra-Large > Large > Medium
notes: industry guide as reported by Wikipedia; bands 71.7-78.5, 66.7-71.6, 58.3-66.6, 50.0-58.2, 41.7-49.9 g

name: New Zealand egg size grades
owner: Egg Producers Federation of New Zealand
steps: Jumbo (8) > Large (7) > Standard (6) > Medium (5) > Pullet (4)

name: Japan boxed hen egg weight classes
steps: LL > L > M > MS > S > SS
notes: MAFF notice 1962 last amended 2003; LL 70-76 g, L 64-70, M 58-64, MS 52-58, S 46-52, SS 40-46

owner: Korea Institute for Animal Products Quality Evaluation
notes: grading by KAPE; grade names from news article

steps: 왕란 > 특란 > 대란 > 중란 > 소란

steps: 特別牛乳 (3.3% fat or more) > 牛乳 (3.0% or more) > 成分調整牛乳 > 低脂肪牛乳 (0.5-1.5%) > 無脂肪牛乳 (under 0.5%)

steps: Scelto > Mezzano > Scarto
notes: Scarto wheels lose the PDO name; text of ONAF document of the consortium specification

name: Parmigiano Reggiano voluntary marks by minimum age
steps: Extra (minimum 24 months) > Export (minimum 18 months)

name: Grana Padano ageing classes
steps: Riserva over 24 months > Riserva over 20 months > over 16 months > from 9 months
notes: page text partly garbled in extraction; classes by months as presented

steps: Green band Comté clochette (14 to 20/20) > Brown band Comté (12 to 14/20)
